_: T1072 store shots, THE ONE SET: 7 frames, the same frames, captions and order for every target (Play phone/7"/10", App Store 6.9"/6.5"). Direction A, "The angler's questions" (owner 2026-11-24 ~23:42: "A. Angler's questions (Recommended)"; first two frames "map then what you can keep but. the what can you keep should show the table not scheudle calendar"). Each title is a question an angler asks, one line under it says what the app answers. Each `scene` is a play-shots.mjs scene from the web app; every capture is the web app (the Spots and Help scenes need a web export built with EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_SHOTS=1, which store-shots/site.mjs builds); the rivers split opens the day's river (store-shots/pick-river.mjs); `compose` stacks real captures under dark caption bars (crops from..to of each part's height, per raw size in `at`, the label bands share what is left, 3-7 % each). `only` (target names) keeps a shot to those sets: none is used. Rules the set meets (enforced in store-shots.mjs): Play's caption block (padding above the card included) at most 20 % of the image height, 2-8 phone shots, PNG, each side 320-3840; the App Store's exact sizes, PNG without alpha, 1-10 per set; no Best/#1/Top/New/Free/Download now, no prices, nothing time-bound in a caption; nothing names a platform or a store.
